gradient_samples: first complete historical effective training batch of each order; identical across arms/nodes,16 appearances, micro8 x accumulation2
gradient_scope: intersection of action/aux differentiable parameters, shared modules only; exclude action-only and auxiliary-only modules

lambda_formula.D-decay: lambda0*(1-k/599), k=successful updates before next step

diagnostic_lambda_at_node: weight for next update, capped at k599 for final600
normalization: per-token/per-coordinate mean over train valid physical anchors x8 horizons x2 appearances, global RAW std from mean/std moments, not residual RMS
target_dtype: float16 stored, float32 normalization then official BF16 loss
gate: one method in BOTH orders Clean>=12/20
seed_scope: two orders, same model initialization/training RNG; not two full seeds
statistics: 20000 bootstrap draws, physical-state clusters jointly retain all appearances/orders; no training-seed or task uncertainty
infrastructure: stop on OOM/CUDA/nonfinite/ECC change; preserve attempts; no automatic retry or device switching
